title: Skeletal Vocabulary Role Association
description: Associates a role from an external skeletal vocabulary with a glTF node. The node index is authoritative; the optional name is diagnostic.

node.description: Index of the associated glTF node in the top-level nodes array.
node.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the top-level `nodes` array. The referenced node is not required to be a member of any `skin.joints` array.

name.description: Diagnostic copy of the referenced node's name.
name.gltf_detailedDescription: When defined, this value MUST exactly and case-sensitively match the `name` property of the node referenced by `node`. Resolution MUST use `node`, not `name`.
